description:
Life lately! Some weeks you just have to stop and look around. 🙏 @marthahigareda 

There was a time I used to be so locked in on what was next that I missed what was right in front of me.
Not anymore.

This week was full. Full of the right people, the right moments, and reminders of why I do all of this. Feeling so blessed and full of gratitude.

What’s one thing from your week you’re grateful for? Drop it below 👇

#Gratitude #DayInTheLife #SchoolOfGreatness
